title: ShareAccess
description: Sharing tier and embed-eligibility for a portal ContentItem (#15). Authoritative wire shape projected from honua-portal#10's `ContentItem.access`. Adds the `group` tier required by #15. Five tiers: private | org | group | public-link | public. `embeddable` is independent of `sharing`: an owner may share publicly without consenting to iframe-from-anywhere.

sharing.description: Audience tier ordered narrowest → widest. Server is authoritative; tier widening triggers a dependency-closure check that may return 409 with blocker ids.

embeddable.description: Whether the item may be rendered inside an iframe at /embed/maps/{id}. Independent of `sharing` — must be explicitly enabled even when `sharing=public`.

groupIds.description: Optional list of group ids this item is shared with. Only populated when `sharing=group`.

publicLinkToken.description: Opaque token segment used in the share link when `sharing=public-link`. Server-managed; rotated on demand. Absent for other tiers.
